page.layout: One printed page (left page of the opening) with running text in one column, a centred calculation display in the middle, and a narrow strip of text at the right edge belonging to the facing page, which is cut off and not transcribed as a column. Running head at top; page number at top left.

main_text.p: diuisionis opus repete. Ac primò quotiente triplicato, factus 75 ita collocabitur, ut prima eius nota sub 6, reliqua sub o designetur: in hoc triplum quotus denuò duplicatus, diuisorem gignit 1875, cuius prima nota sub 7 posteriore tripli nota collocabitur. Cùm dein uideas 1 in 7 saepiùs quidè contineri, uerùm non nisi quater sumi posse, 4 pro quoto sepone, tumq; multiplica 4 in diuisorem, factus erit 7500, mox quadratū eius in triplum 75, factus erit 1200. Postremò ex eadē quoti nota cubū cōstitue, nēpe 64: facti hi omnes addit, sunt 762064, qui à dato cubo remotus, nihil relinquit, quod indicio est, datū numerū exactè cubicū fuisse. Inductio tertia sic est:
¶ Regia uia inueniendi lateris Cubici mōstrata est. Sunt autem porrò & aliæ quædam eōdem deducentes, eodemq; quinetiam principio nitentes. Altera quidem hæc est.

page.notes: The calculation display is set as a centred block of numbers with dot marks and lines; transcribed line by line as lines of the display. Some digits in the display are uncertain (e.g. the superscript-like dots and the factor 7 in "+63 87" row). The right-edge strip is the facing page's text, cut off; only partial words are visible and were not transcribed as text. The catchword "Inuen-" is at the foot and was included as the last line of text.
